experiment_data.hypothesis: DeBERTa-v3-base (LoRA) end-to-end 4-class depth classification on pythia_temp09 cell achieves lower accuracy than RF+19-feature baseline, confirming cross-model generality of "simple features beat neural" finding. Paired with gpt2xl_temp09 pilot to cover both strong and weak atlas cells.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/autodl-tmp/recursive_gen_depth_est && python scripts/deberta_depth_pilot.py --cell pythia_temp09 --gpu 0 --output_dir results/deberta_pilot"
